scope.question: Does the formulaic search preserve every attempted trial and bind evidence to a complete experiment identity?

evidence: mining/__init__.py accumulates admitted and history only in process memory and returns them after the entire search iterator finishes
scripts/mine_alphas.py calls mine_alphas before write_jsonl; there is no per-candidate durable write or exception-finally row
write_jsonl opens the destination with mode w only after a successful run
findings.implication: Any evaluation exception, OOM, interruption or iterator failure erases every attempted candidate since run start. The surviving JSONL is therefore not a conserved trial population and cannot support honest multiplicity or failure-cohort inference.
findings.repair_test: Prewrite one immutable PLANNED row per candidate identity, transition it through RUNNING to COMPLETE or typed FAILED in finally/transactional code, kill the worker after candidate k, and prove planned = complete + failed + explicitly_unattempted after restart.

evidence: AutoAlphaProvenance stores expression, generation, seed, parent, mutation kind, operator-set string, feature-set string, evidence, timestamp and admission decision
it stores no code commit, data hash/vintage, terminal-universe snapshot, panel date range, label horizon, search configuration, gate configuration or cost specification
the CLI output rows likewise omit the command/run manifest containing those fields
findings.implication: The same apparent candidate identity can carry evidence produced by different data, horizons, universes, costs or gate semantics. Reproduction from seed is claimed more strongly than the persisted identity supports.
findings.repair_test: Changing only one Fusion symbol contract, one cost field, the horizon, the date window, code commit or gate-policy version must change the run/cell identity and forbid cached-evidence reuse.

evidence: load_panel_frame silently skips any contract whose bar directory is missing, empty, or yields no rows
the run proceeds when at least one instrument remains and reports only loaded row/instrument counts
the output carries neither the requested roster nor missing-symbol dispositions
findings.implication: A nominal full-universe experiment can become a convenient survivor subset without changing its persisted identity; absence is read as clean ground.
findings.repair_test: Persist requested terminal roster, loaded roster and one typed reason per missing symbol; reject any unreconciled roster before publishing evidence.

evidence: EvolutionarySearch selects parents by the same cached rank_ic computed from the fold aggregate
AdmissionGate then admits on that same aggregate
there is no outer untouched selection holdout in the inspected mining path
findings.implication: The walk-forward label describes temporal folding, not untouched post-selection evidence. It may rank candidates for research but cannot confer promotion authority.
findings.repair_test: Freeze the generated population and search decisions before evaluating a separately sealed holdout, then send only canonical ten-gate certificates to the desk's universal forward engine.

evidence: scripts/mine_alphas.py defines _build_initial_baseline as unused and returns None
mine_alphas starts running_baseline from baseline_features or an empty mapping
AdmissionGate explicitly treats NaN correlation from no baseline as acceptable
findings.implication: Correlation pruning is only within one invocation. Re-running with a new seed can admit a near-copy of a prior run while both rows individually say admitted.
findings.repair_test: Load the active and historical accepted feature population point-in-time before search; an identical candidate in a later run must receive the same identity or a typed redundancy disposition, never a fresh admission.

economic_disposition.mt5_translation: The process findings map to every terminal-enumerated Fusion candidate cell. No source factor, direction, symbol or horizon survived, so none was invented.
economic_disposition.costs: No market construction was tested. Any later Fusion cell must bind point-in-time bid/ask, spread, commission, realised slippage/partial-fill markout, swap and contract terms before the canonical ten gates.
economic_disposition.expected_log_wealth_effect: Positive through false-evidence withdrawal and through preventing missing, duplicate or semantically-reused trials from corrupting multiplicity, independence and capital admission; magnitude unmeasured until the repair is instrumented.
